propositions: Real CLI execution must route through the validated registry system instead of parallel explicit intercept/dispatch ladders and policy frozensets.
Only the selected lazy handler reference and its S2 argparse factory are resolved and imported; unrelated handlers and optional stacks remain unimported.
Registry-derived mount eligibility, initialization policy (none/init_only/full), and conditional selectors must match pre-cutover census behavior including no-auto-mount cases.
Top-level router preserves original command remainder argv and selected handler parses exactly once without route-level option grammar or second parse.
Confirmation, global output extraction, legacy JSON passthrough, token preservation after --, streams, exit codes, and exception propagation preserve existing behavioral contracts.
